Course materials for learning R, data wrangling, visualization, and data cleaning in a world where AI writes much of the code and **you navigate and audit it**.

## The Audit Loop

1. **Read** the code
2. **Run** it
3. **Restate** it in plain English
4. **Refine** it or **Reject** it

## Sessions

New sessions appear in the table below as they are published. Slides are for class and handouts are the detailed reference. Lab's 2 and 3 instructions will be pushed into your team's repo when the time comes.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
# One row per lecture. Finds every *_slides.qmd and *_handout.qmd, skips drafts,
# and pairs them by file-name prefix (e.g., W04L07_slides + W04L07_handout).
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
files <- list.files(pattern = "_(slides|handout)\\.qmd$")
meta <- lapply(files, function(f) {
  fm <- rmarkdown::yaml_front_matter(f)
  if (isTRUE(fm$draft)) return(NULL)
  data.frame(
    lecture = sub("_(slides|handout)\\.qmd$", "", f),
    kind    = sub("^.*_(slides|handout)\\.qmd$", "\\1", f),
    title   = fm$title %||% "",
    desc    = fm$description %||% "",
    date    = as.character(fm$date %||% ""),
    html    = sub("\\.qmd$", ".html", f)
  )
})
meta <- do.call(rbind, meta)
esc <- function(x) htmltools::htmlEscape(x)
if (!is.null(meta)) {
  rows <- lapply(split(meta, meta$lecture), function(d) {
    s <- d[d$kind == "slides", ]; h <- d[d$kind == "handout", ]
    first <- if (nrow(s)) s else h
    link <- function(x, label) if (nrow(x)) sprintf('<a href="%s">%s</a>', x$html, label) else "&ndash;"
    list(date = first$date, lecture = d$lecture[1],
         html = sprintf("<tr><td>%s</td><td><strong>%s</strong><br><span class='text-muted'>%s</span></td><td>%s</td><td>%s</td></tr>",
                        esc(first$date), esc(first$title), esc(first$desc), link(s, "Slides"), link(h, "Handout")))
  })
  ord <- order(vapply(rows, `[[`, "", "date"), vapply(rows, `[[`, "", "lecture"))
  cat('<table class="table table-hover">\n<thead><tr><th>Date</th><th>Session</th><th>Slides</th><th>Handout</th></tr></thead>\n<tbody>\n',
      paste(vapply(rows[ord], `[[`, "", "html"), collapse = "\n"), '\n</tbody></table>\n', sep = "")
}
```

Course datasets for in-class examples: [movies.csv](data/movies.csv), [studios.csv](data/studios.csv), [movies.parquet](data/movies.parquet)
